mapper.select: SELECT daily_new_otp_limit FROM tenant_sms_limits WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_sms_limits (tenant_id, daily_new_otp_limit, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{limit}, #{now}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET daily_new_otp_limit = EXCLUDED.daily_new_otp_limit, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM sms_messages WHERE purpose = 'OTP' AND created_at >= #{since}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_limit_alerts (day, scope, level, created_at) VALUES (#{day}, #{scope}, #{level}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
